title: Service of process.
bodyText: The board of directors of the corporation shall establish a policy to provide reasonable access to persons authorized to serve civil process in compliance with section 634-21.5.
bodyHtml: §421I-13  Service of process.  The board of directors of the corporation shall establish a policy to provide reasonable access to persons authorized to serve civil process in compliance with section 634-21.5. [L 2009, c 158, §§1, 8; am L 2011, c 65, §1]
